message: PctWidget: in the package and not in the sources — widget-root
$reason: A stale `dist`: the package was built while the component's `host` block still wrote a root part, the attribute's name in capitals, and the sources have dropped it since. `hostAttrs` keep the name as written, `'DATA-PCT-PART', 'widget-root'` (measured through ngc in partial mode and the linker on an object spread into the block; the class in `package.json` carries the declaration ngc writes), and the DOM lowercases it into a part a consumer's selector matches. The case holds the `hostAttrs` half of the package read, as `part-in-capitals-in-a-stale-package` holds the `consts` half: compared as written, the package lists no part either, and the case passes every point. It stood on a spread the scanner did not follow until the read followed it (`part-in-capitals-in-a-spread-constant`); a stale `dist` leans on no gap of the scanner.
